test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given sentence and select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Straighten’ from the following options.

The soldiers were crouching and crawling behind the fence to take a better shot at the enemies and surprise them.
solution:
The correct answer is crouching.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Straighten' is 'crouching'.
 
• Straighten: to become straight or to make something straight.
 
• Meaning of the given options:
 
 
• fence: a line of wooden or metal posts joined by wood, wire, metal, etc. to divide land or to keep in animals
 
• crouching: to bend your legs and body so that you are close to the ground
 
• surprise: the feeling that you have when something happens that you do not expect
 
• enemies: a person who hates and tries to harm you
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.​
